name: Harness-Agnostic Core Abstraction
description: Extracts all business logic from AGY-coupled code into @superconductor/core package. Each harness (AGY, Claude Desktop, OpenCode, VSCode, CLI) becomes a thin adapter. The MCP server pattern established by design-os-kernel is extended to expose all Superconductor capabilities to any MCP-compatible harness. Migrates 7 review scripts to core, adds track management module, agent context protocol, and universal CLI adapter.
